name: boundhound
description: Autonomous pentest agent with enforced, deny-by-default scope safety. Phase 7: recon + enumeration + bounded exploitation + verified findings + reporting, orchestrated end to end by /fullscan through the same enforced bh-exec choke point, now resumable across interruption (--resume) with bounded retry of transient tool failures (--max-retries) and hard run/stage step budgets (--max-steps / --max-steps-per-stage).
